lines.reference: Pumpkin, raw — USDA FDC 168448: 26 kcal / 100 g
Butter, salted — USDA FDC 173410: 717 kcal / 100 g
Whole cinnamon stick, lifted out before serving — none counted
Sugars, brown — USDA FDC 168833: 380 kcal / 100 g
Spices, cinnamon, ground — USDA FDC 171320: 247 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions that change the number: pumpkin taken, not butternut (butternut would add ~285 kcal to the pot, ~50 a serving); cinnamon sticks lifted out; all of the syrup eaten. Sanity check: the closest USDA dish is candied sweet potato, home-prepared (FDC 170088) at 164 kcal / 100 g; ours is ~75 kcal / 100 g (~1.44 kg), lower because pumpkin has a third of sweet potato's starch (USDA 26 against 86 kcal / 100 g raw). Per serving, two-thirds of the energy is the butter and sugar. The web search budget ran out before a published soetpampoen figure could be found.
